title_en: Eastman Kodak Company v. Suzhou Koda Hydraulic Elevator Co., Ltd. — dispute over trademark infringement
ruling_gist_en: 1. In the trial of a trademark infringement dispute case, the people's court's determination of whether the involved trademark constitutes a well-known trademark is a determination of the basic facts of the case and is not limited by the parties' claims.
